thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the RBAC tweak to the keystore service account last night we started seeing multiple failures: nightly SAST job errors during fixture decrypt, CI build-agent can't decrypt test artifacts, and Stackdriver audits aren't showing kms:Decrypt calls from the deployer SA. PR I think was 4892? Anyone have the change context? :eyes:

sam: that was my PR (4892). I removed the 'roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter' binding for serviceAccount:keystore-deployer@redwood-prod. Was trying to tighten perms. didn't expect CI to use that SA directly. sorry — can revert if that's the quickest unblock. which job is failing exactly?

maria: nightly/sast-runner -> job 2026-03-20-03:00. error snippet: ```
ERROR: KMS decrypt failed: PermissionDenied: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/fixtures: decrypting failed for ciphertext ...
Caused by: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:keystore-deployer@redwood-prod.
```

jon: ok. first step: confirm audit log entries for that SA around 03:00. run: ```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=project AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"serviceAccount:keystore-deployer@redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.methodName:kms.*Decrypt" --freshness=7d --limit=50 --format=json
```
that will show if decrypt requests reached KMS and were denied or if requests never surfaced.

anya: temporary remediation path: re-grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to keystore-deployer in infra-prod for 1h while we triage. Better long-term: move CI to impersonate a short-lived SA that only has decrypt rights for the specific key version. Also add a smoke test in pre-deploy to attempt a KMS decrypt of a zero-byte fixture.

maria: SAST pipeline creates noise because it treats failed decrypt as code failure: we get >200 findings from the run that are unrelated. Can security mute the SAST run for this job and mark any findings as infra-fail until keys are back? We need to preserve evidence for later triage though.

sec-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026. Owner assigned: sam. Priority: P2. Evidence retention flag set to 14d pending backfill.

sam: I can revert the RBAC change now. quick fix: ```
resource "google_project_iam_member" "keystore_decrypt" {
  project = "redwood-prod"
  role    = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member  = "serviceAccount:keystore-deployer@redwood-prod"
}
```
I'll open a PR to reapply with ttl annotation (short-lived) and we can land it after review.

jon: Also recommend adding an alert: metric "logging/entries_count" filter on protoPayload.methodName:kms.*Decrypt AND severity=ERROR for serviceAccount:keystore-deployer — threshold 5 in 5m -> Pager to eng-sre. If decrypts stop showing up entirely, alert that too (possible permission/ingestion gap).

anya: On the SDLC side: we should add a checklist item for any RBAC removal that could touch keys: 1) run the decrypt smoke test, 2) confirm audit logs visible for the SA, 3) coordinate with infra@sre and sec. I'll draft an RFC/PR to add to the pre-merge security checklist.

maria: also need to handle SAST findings noise: propose creating a temporary evidence label "infra-failure:SEC-2026" and filter in the SAST dashboard so triage folks don't waste cycles. Can SecOps do that?

sam: reverting now and will post PR. if anyone wants to review quickly: DRAFT PR 4901.

oncall-sre: applying revert to infra-prod now (rolling): terraform apply in infra-prod workspace. ETA ~4m. will follow up with logs.

oncall-sre: revert applied. confirmed KMS decrypt calls from keystore-deployer appearing in audit: ran jon's command and got multiple entries between 03:01-03:05 that show PERMISSION_DENIED before revert and SUCCESS after revert.

maria: verified — nightly/sast-runner completed a new run and decrypt succeeded; infra-generated findings reduced. marking SEC-2026 as 'mitigated' pending policy PR.

jon: I'll run a backfill query for 72h of audit logs to capture evidence for the incident and attach to SEC-2026 ticket.

anya: I'll author the SDLC checklist PR and include a template for short-lived grants (ttl & justification) + how to annotate PRs that change keystore/KMS bindings. assigning to @anya for the PR and @sam for the revert follow-up.

sam: will update PR 4901 to include TTL and link to SEC-2026 in description.

maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: jon (audit backfill), anya (SDLC checklist PR), sam (finalize revert + ttl code), sec-ops please keep SAST evidence flagged for 14d. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: last note — recommend we add an automated pre-merge CI job `infra-smoke/kms-decrypt` to catch this early. forwarding to eng-infra to add to the infra pipeline.
